name: stc-toolkit
description: Build and flash common STC MCU projects from VS Code (Keil + stcgal/custom backends).

stcToolkit.projectFile.description: Keil .uvproj/.uvprojx path. Leave empty to auto-detect.

stcToolkit.keil.uv4Path.description: Path to UV4.exe. Used to build C51/C251 Keil projects.

stcToolkit.build.customCommand.description: Optional custom build command. If set, it is used instead of UV4.exe. Supports ${workspaceFolder} and ${projectFile}.

stcToolkit.firmwareFile.description: HEX/IHX firmware path. Leave empty to auto-select the newest firmware file after build.

stcToolkit.flash.backend.description: Flashing backend. stcgal provides direct flashing for many common STC parts; custom runs a user command; official launches STC-ISP.

stcToolkit.flash.stcgalPath.description: stcgal executable or command name (for example stcgal or python -m stcgal).

stcToolkit.flash.protocol.description: stcgal protocol. Auto works for many UART targets; STC32 commonly maps to stc8d in stcgal.

stcToolkit.flash.port.description: Serial port such as COM3. Leave empty and use STC: Select Serial Port. Ignored by USB-only protocols.

stcToolkit.flash.baud.description: Programming baud rate for stcgal UART mode.

stcToolkit.flash.autoreset.description: Pass -a to stcgal for DTR/RTS based automatic power cycling when the hardware supports it.

stcToolkit.officialIspPath.description: Path to the official STC-ISP/AiCube executable for fallback/manual flashing.
